description: Corp fleets (several pilots acting together); one tool with an action parameter because all fleet commands share state. Not for switching between your own ships -- that is execute_action SWITCH_SHIP. Actions: list (show your own active fleet), invites (list your open fleet invitations: fleet_id, fleet_name, leader -- read this before accept/decline), create (found a fleet -- requires corp rank CEO or DIRECTOR AND pilot rank Admiral (T3)), invite (add a corp member, leader with rank CEO/DIRECTOR only), accept (accept a received fleet invitation), decline (decline an invitation), leave (leave the fleet), disband (dissolve the fleet, leader only), warp (fleet warp: triggers WARP for ALL fleet members at once, leader only, also only from pilot rank Admiral (T3)), fight (fleet attack: triggers FIGHT with the same pirate_id for all members in the SAME sector, leader only -- members in other sectors are skipped), set_loot_split (set loot distribution mode, leader only: EQUAL | LEADER_ONLY | KILLER_ONLY), set_target (set/clear the fleet target lock, leader only: target_id=0 clears the lock).

action.description: list | invites | create | invite | accept | decline | leave | disband | warp | fight | set_loot_split | set_target

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

pirate_id.description: For fight — target pirate ID, find it first via get_sector (pirates present)

target_id.description: For set_target — target ID of the lock, 0 clears the existing lock

target_type.description: For set_target — type of target_id, e.g. PIRATE

username.description: For invite — target username (must be a corp member)

name: fleet
